text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week has managed to find
success in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the glory
of our
accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer! Are you there?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-hi! Hehe, sorry for stopping by out of
nowhere
like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh... Well... actually!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Do you wanna go on a trip to Hokkaido
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's asking me to tag
along on a
visit to her home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sorry for asking you out of the
blue earlier.
I don't know why, but I was
really nervous about
it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But anyway, thank you for coming!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to introduce you for
the longest
time since I managed to do
well in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna introduce you to my moms in

person—like, "Hey! This is my trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And I wanna tell them that I've grown so
much
because you've been by my side!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The train rocking along, Special Week
smiles
bashfully as we think about the
fun trip ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...But things don't quite go as planned.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Wait, whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been following Special Week, who
insists that
she's a confident grown-up.
However...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh, no! D-don't be silly! What did I say
before?
I've totally grown up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So there's absolutely no way... I'd... get...
lost. I'm
pretty sure we took the right
train...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sooooo sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week and I are whipped into a
panic over
the possibility of missing our
flight, when—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Someone's calling me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hellooooo? Spe? You just realized that
you're
lost, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-Sei?! How'd you know?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I realized you mentioned the
wrong train
name when you were reading
out your travel
itinerary yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Oh, Spe. You're as hopeless as
ever!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Where are you right now? We will find
the
shortest route, so please stay calm
and talk to us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww, Grass and El too... You guys!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We... We made it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! Let's buy them mountains of

souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I also gotta add this to the list of things
to tell my
mom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That I've got lots of friends... who are
also my
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And that I've gotten stronger because I
race
against them with everything I've
got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniff... phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. That smell takes me back. It's
the smell
of home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's head to my house and say hi to my
mom...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then I want you to come with me to
visit my
other mom's grave. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You've believed in me and my dream
and
supported me from the very
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How do you see me now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm proud of myself too!
